races.paceDynamic: And She Was appears the only confirmed front runner in this field, with Uncle Remus, Collanisi and Prince Rhinegold likely to track her in the early stages. With minimal pace pressure, And She Was can dictate terms and set a sustainable gallop, though her pulled-up effort last time raises reliability concerns. The lack of genuine speed means this will develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial approaching the final flight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and patient hold-up horses who can time their challenges, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If And She Was sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks. Penn Avenue, Forever Penywern and Berkshire Smudge benefit from patient rides and strong staying power over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If Uncle Remus or Prince Rhinegold track the leader closely and strike approaching the last
scenarios.body: The prominent horses avoid the risk of traffic problems while staying close enough to capitalise when the pace lifts. Uncle Remus uses his bumper-winning stamina while Prince Rhinegold draws on recent good form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If And She Was compounds or fades badly, leaving no clear leader turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy tactical affair with multiple challengers hitting the front simultaneously. This favours the most battle-hardened handicappers who can quicken in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-To-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If And She Was improves dramatically from her pulled-up effort and maintains her lead throughout
scenarios.body: The mare gets an uncontested lead and finds enough stamina to repel all challengers despite her poor recent form. Alan King's three winners from 21 runners suggests stable form is patchy but not impossible.

watchPoints.text: And She Was could compound early if her fitness issues from the pulled-up run persist, leaving no pace in the race
Walk In The West tends to fade in the finish so watch for early signs of weakening approaching the final flight
Uncle Remus returns after 186 days off so monitor for any signs of rustiness in the early stages
Penn Avenue switches from soft to good ground with an inexperienced claimer, watch market confidence levels
Prince Rhinegold carries bottom weight but has regular off days, so early body language will be telling

races.paceDynamic: Idaho Fire looks the only natural early pace angle in this small field, likely to lead uncontested from the start. Fairye Forth and Getaway Vic will track prominently behind, but neither appears keen to press hard early. The moderate early gallop will allow hold-up horses Kind Intention and Mariniere to stay closer than usual, with Yellow Card likely trailing. This sets up a sustained drive from halfway where stamina and tactical positioning matter more than pure speed - favouring prominent trackers who can quicken off the steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Idaho Fire leads without pressure and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The rhythm allows Fairye Forth to settle perfectly and unleash his superior class rating in the straight. His C&D form two weeks ago gives him a clear edge when the race develops into a staying test rather than speed contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Idaho Fire gets an easy lead and has enough left to resist late challenges
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds a crucial advantage turning for home and his stamina holds up. Paul Nicholls' charge proves his bumper promise was genuine and outbattles the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Kind Intention gets the perfect setup for his debut over hurdles, tracking the slow pace perfectly. His bumper form behind smart horses like Storming George proves decisive when he unleashes his turn of foot late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Layoff Returns Fire
scenarios.trigger: If Getaway Vic's 390-day absence proves no hindrance and his bumper form translates
scenarios.body: The Mickey Bowen-trained gelding shakes off the rust quickly and his 2-3 bumper record shows true. James Bowen gets him into the perfect stalking position to strike approaching the last.

watchPoints.text: Idaho Fire stopping quickly again if pressured - has disappointed when asked serious questions in his last two hurdle starts
Getaway Vic showing signs of ring rustiness early given his 390-day absence since last competitive outing
Mariniere fading tamely in the straight as her recent form suggests stamina limitations at this trip
Kind Intention jumping fluently on hurdle debut as bumper horses can struggle with the obstacles first time
Fairye Forth travelling as smoothly as he did when second at this C&D two weeks ago on similar going

races.paceDynamic: Parliamo represents the most obvious pace-setter with his prominent style and stamina-laden pedigree, likely to establish a measured tempo over this 3-mile trip. With only one confirmed front-runner and several hold-up horses including Times Are Green, Les's Destiny Star, and Star Turn, this sets up as a steady gallop that will quicken from the second-last hurdle. The lack of early pace pressure means the gallop may be too sedate for the prominent runners to assert, creating a tactical affair that builds late. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can produce finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is modest and the race builds from 2 out
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses prove perfect as they sweep past tiring leaders in the final half-mile. The lack of early pressure allows closers to conserve energy for decisive late strikes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Parliamo and the prominent duo kick clear turning in
scenarios.body: Constantinian and Hillwalk capitalise on their forward positions when the pace quickens, getting first run on the field. Their class and proximity to the pace proves decisive against horses with ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes truly searching throughout
scenarios.body: The strong 3-mile pace finds out several runners as only those with proven stamina reserves can sustain their effort. Parliamo's pedigree and Times Are Green's staying potential become crucial factors in a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into a crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure speed trumps stamina, catching several hold-up horses flat-footed. Those with tactical speed and good positioning benefit from the sudden injection of pace.

races.paceDynamic: Buckna is the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without early pressure, as most of the field comprises prominent or hold-up horses. The Boola Boss, Hell Hound, Imperial Alex, Copshill Lad and Arrycan will track behind in the prominent positions, while Karuma Grey, Galop De Chasse, Fairlawn Flyer and Balkardy will be held up further back. With only one natural leader and plenty of patient riders, this sets up as a slowly-run affair that will become a sprint from the final fence. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken late, as they'll get the strong gallop they need in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays slow until the home turn as expected
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade will be perfectly suited as they can unleash their finishing kicks. Karuma Grey and Fairlawn Flyer are best positioned to capitalise on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can get first run on the leaders
scenarios.body: The Boola Boss or Copshill Lad could exploit their forward position to steal a march before the hold-up horses can respond. Their recent form suggests they have the class to make it count.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Buckna Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setter can dictate throughout without serious challenge
scenarios.body: Buckna's uncontested lead could prove decisive if he can maintain his gallop to the line. His proven stamina over this trip gives him an outside chance of wire-to-wire success.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and no one can quicken decisively
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddled affair where any horse with a pulse of speed can win. This randomness could favour an outsider who gets the right splits at the right time.

races.paceDynamic: Alba Crus will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in this field, allowing him to dictate an uncontested pace through the early stages. This Sway, Albert Park, Kylenoe Dancer and Play On Court will sit prominently behind the leader, while the majority including Lion Of The Desert, Bells Of Ufford, Mind Hunter and Mancero will track from mid-division or further back. With Alba Crus likely to set a steady tempo without pressure, the pace will build gradually, setting up a finish where horses need to find their effort from the back half of the field. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the sustainable early pace will leave plenty in reserve for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Crus sets an uncontested lead allowing the pace to remain steady through halfway
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop will suit patient tactics perfectly, with Lion Of The Desert and Mancero ideally placed to mount late challenges having both shown strong finishing kicks recently. Those held up off the steady pace will have plenty left for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can maintain close order behind Alba Crus without being asked for too much effort early
scenarios.body: This Sway and Kylenoe Dancer will be perfectly positioned to challenge from the second flight, with their proven ability to travel strongly in behind pace-setters. The moderate early gallop will leave them with enough in reserve to quicken when needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Crus maintains a strong gallop from the front and the field fails to mount a serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of other pace-pressers could allow Alba Crus to dictate completely, maintaining enough in reserve to resist late challengers despite his long absence. His previous good ground success suggests he can handle this assignment if getting his own way in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very steady early allowing mid-field runners to stay closer than usual to the leaders
scenarios.body: Horses like Dublin To Milan or Jukebox Joker could benefit from improved positioning if the early pace is crawling, though both have significant form concerns. The tactical advantage might outweigh their ability deficits if they can get into contention earlier than expected.

watchPoints.text: Lion Of The Desert could dominate if his course and distance success translates with only a small penalty to overcome
Alba Crus returning after 110 days may not have the fitness to sustain his front-running tactics throughout

races.paceDynamic: L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack will dispute the early lead, with L'Empire Vert's superior class likely seeing him dictate terms through the first half of the race. Both front-runners have shown they can sustain their efforts, so expect an honest gallop throughout rather than a crawl. The sustained pace will stretch the field and expose any fitness doubts, particularly affecting the hold-up horses returning from breaks like Radharc Na Slaine and Of Corse I Can. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina who can track the pace and deliver when it counts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack maintain a strong pace throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will suit the classier animals who can travel well in behind and have the ability to quicken when required. Horses like Loki's Mischief and Boston Joe with their higher ratings will thrive when the race becomes a test of class over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong for both L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack
scenarios.body: The sustained early gallop will take its toll on the leaders, allowing the better-handicapped hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. Bahtiyar's recent form and light weight make him perfectly positioned to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: L'Empire Vert Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If L'Empire Vert can shake off Rangatira Jack and control the pace solo
scenarios.body: His class advantage and Brendan Powell's tactical nous allow him to dictate ideal fractions before finding extra when challenged. The prominent runners tracking him will struggle to match his sustained kick up the hill.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fitness Questions Prove Costly
scenarios.trigger: If the returning horses from breaks fail to handle the sustained pace
scenarios.body: Radharc Na Slaine's 187-day absence and Of Corse I Can's 130-day layoff become telling factors as the race develops into a stamina test. The race-fit horses who have run recently will prove superior in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Rangatira Jack's recent poor form despite market support last time could see him fold quickly if pressured early by L'Empire Vert
Radharc Na Slaine's 187-day absence makes his fitness a major question mark despite his previous course success at Stratford
Bahtiyar showed good form at Warwick just 12 days ago and the quick turnaround suggests connections are confident about his condition
Jack's A Legend is making only his third chase start and his Newton Abbot mistake at the second-last fence highlights jumping concerns
Boston Joe's consistency in similar company makes him a reliable each-way option despite Rebecca Curtis's recent poor strike rate
